meta.triageRationale: bugfix/small: one function and its caller, reuses the existing range-base resolver.

body.focus: A trivial standalone build's validate gate runs the test files touched across the build's range (from resolveStoryRangeBase, src/workflow/runners/build/range-base.ts:327, the same base the change log and typecheck use), falling back to the HEAD commit only when no range base resolves. trivialCheckPlan (src/daemon/steps/build-step/validation-checks.ts:323-338) and its caller (src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases/validate.ts:348). Tests show a test committed earlier in the range is run when a later commit is HEAD, and the HEAD fallback still applies with no base. Implements ISSUE-91640defac1b5816.
body.summary: Commit 08c023de: trivialCheckPlan(repoPath, base?) lists __tests__/*.test.ts files changed in base..HEAD when a base resolves, else the HEAD commit's (unchanged fallback); handleStandaloneValidate passes resolveStoryRangeBase(repoPath, epicHash, storyId). Tests: validation-checks.test.ts (range across three commits vs the HEAD fallback) and build-start.test.ts (a real trivial validate under a later records commit plans the stamped range's test file). Two falsifying mutations (caller passes no base; base ignored) each fail a test. Full sweep: tsc clean; failures are the 2 pre-existing ones (sqlite-driver, review-decision) plus src/db/lance/__tests__/cleanup.test.ts, which hung under sweep load and passes 8/8 alone.
